tagline: A place where people turn ideas into software.
description: FedPromptly is a builder ecosystem connecting practical learning, useful tools, open development, experiments, and community pathways.

projects.name: FedPromptly Ecosystem
projects.description: The parent world connecting learning, tools, developers, Labs, and future infrastructure concepts.
projects.audience: Curious people, builders, developers, and supporters
projects.whatYouCanDo: Read the map, choose a pathway, and start with one small build.

projects.name: Fed-EDU
projects.description: Practical learning through creation: short explanations, guided projects, and beginner-friendly paths.
projects.whatYouCanDo: Use the learning direction to shape a starter project.

projects.name: FedPromptly Labs
projects.description: A home for prototypes, tests, odd ideas, and projects that are still becoming.
projects.whatYouCanDo: Document an experiment, share what broke, or propose a small test.

projects.name: Builder Templates Library
projects.description: A future collection of small starting points for websites, Python tools, AI experiments, automations, portfolios, and blogs.
projects.audience: People who know what they want to make but need a starting point
projects.whatYouCanDo: Suggest a template or turn a working project into a documented starter.

projects.name: Builder Showcase
projects.description: A place for released tools, new builds, experiments, and community projects to be seen as work in progress.
projects.audience: Builders looking for examples and collaborators
projects.whatYouCanDo: Submit a project with its current status and what you learned.

projects.name: FedOS Concepts
projects.description: Long-horizon concepts for a connected ecosystem of tools, distribution, sensing, and networked builder infrastructure.
projects.whatYouCanDo: Treat this as a direction for questions, not a shipped product.
